rounds.q: What % of US adults rarely or never drive a car?
rounds.why: In cities it's 18%, about double the rate in suburbs (7%) and rural areas (8%).
rounds.src: Pew Research Center, Survey of US adults (2024)
rounds.fun: Only one in ten adults skips the driver's seat. Road trip, anyone?

rounds.q: What % of US adults have extended family within an hour's drive?
rounds.why: 28% say most or all of their extended family lives within an hour.
rounds.src: Pew Research Center, Survey of US adults (2021)
rounds.fun: Four in five adults have some family within an hour. Who's hosting dinner?

rounds.q: What % of US adults know all or most of their neighbors?
rounds.why: In 2018, 31% said they knew all or most of their neighbors.
rounds.src: Pew Research Center, Survey of US adults (2025)
rounds.fun: Only about one in four adults knows most of the neighbors. Time to wave hello!

rounds.q: What % of Americans volunteered with a group in 2023?
rounds.why: Even more, 54%, helped their neighbors in informal ways.
rounds.src: AmeriCorps and US Census Bureau, Volunteering and Civic Life in America (2023)
rounds.fun: More than one in four Americans volunteered. Helping hands everywhere!

rounds.q: What % of US adults say they don't know how to swim?
rounds.why: 55% of US adults say they never took a swimming lesson.
rounds.src: CDC, MMWR Vital Signs, NCHS Rapid Surveys System (2023)
rounds.fun: Most adults can swim, but about one in seven can't. Cannonball? Maybe not.
